content:
The line is \(3x+4y=5\). The circle has center \((a,1)\) and radius \(4\).

Tangency condition:
\[
\frac{|3a+4(1)-5|}{\sqrt{3^2+4^2}}=4
\]
\[
\frac{|3a-1|}{5}=4 \implies |3a-1|=20
\]
\[
3a-1=20 \quad \text{or} \quad 3a-1=-20
\]
\[
a=7 \quad \text{or} \quad a=-\frac{19}{3}
\]

Since \(a>0\), we have \(a=7\).

\[
\boxed{7}
\]
